clips.title: The story
paras: At Winterhoof Water Well, the Venture Company threatens Mulgore's water supply. The well lies south of Bloodhoof Village, at the edge of the Rolling Plains, where tauren tribes and roaming herds depend on its fresh water.

Water from deep wells sustains Mulgore's herds and tauren encampments. Winterhoof Water Well draws from aquifers beneath the Rolling Plains and bears the name of one of the plains' respected tribes. Now the Venture Company has targeted this vital source. The goblin cartel has tried to poison the water and gain control over the surrounding territory.
